# Which test suites read which area

Type: research
Status: resolved
Area: 2, the test harness
Blocked by: none
Findings: [research/test-suites.md](../research/test-suites.md), written when it resolves
Map: [The field guide rebuild: the map](../map.md)

## Question

Which test suites read which area of the app, so a move knows which suite turns red?

## Pointers

- The grill's page, [shared-understanding.md](../shared-understanding.md), *Shape*.
- The research notes beside the map, [research-official-docs.md](../research-official-docs.md).

## Answer

Nine suites. Three of them read every area through the shared sample trip, so a single move turns most of them red at once.
